title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing — Episode5 As Her Close Friend

meta.Event Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Line: Shopping Mall
Toy Store

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: ...which is why I decided to buy these things for playing competitive Hanetsuki.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And now, we're looking at what other New Year's games this toy store has to offer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, that's excellent!
Not only would it make for a new and fun stream, you could form teams and play against each other.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, and since you're going to play Hanetsuki, it might be good to let the winners draw on the losers, as is tradition.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If you're worried about the ink, you could substitute it with skin-safe stickers instead.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, good point...!
It'd be really cute if we got plastered with stickers every time we make a mistake. Lemme take a look...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why are you muttering like that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: U-Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-I'm recording ideas for our stream on my phone! So that I don't forget!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize you took notes like that. I guess I shouldn't expect anything less from you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
Anyway, I'm just glad that we have everything we need for playing competitive Hanetsuki now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We sorta got lucky, huh? They were running surprisingly low.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, we managed to secure our own sets, too.
...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...?
What's wrong, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... I've never actually spent this much time in a toy store before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's been an interesting experience, since I'm seeing most of these toys for the very first time. Even the ones that look familiar are ones that I'd never played with.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I noticed that they have an interactive corner for their New Year's products.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An interactive corner?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, where you can test out some of the toys they have on this floor.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't know about that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, it sounds like fun, so wanna go check it out?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It might help me come up with more ideas for our stream, so I wanna try what they have! Also, it's not every day that you get to play with spinning tops or Kendama.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kendama...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah... You wanna give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, we don't have anything else planned, so I guess it wouldn't hurt to check it out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Cool!
Then, let's go see what they have!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: N-Now...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Th-This is very difficult...
I'm struggling to get the ball to land in even the biggest cup...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, everyone has a hard time in the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you had no trouble getting it to land in the smallest cup, Akito. Is there some sort of trick involved?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, I don't know if I'd call it a trick...
Instead of just using your arm, you want to bend your knees like this to basically cushion the fall...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
These look like the spinning tops.
Hehe. I remember playing with these over at my grandma's house.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If I recall, you're supposed to wrap the string around like this and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Spin...!
Hey, not bad! There it goes!
se_event_unfading_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that doesn't seem too hard.
I might be able to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, you wrap it around like this and... Spin?
se_event_unfading_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, it's not spinning at all! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There...!
se_event_unfading_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You've improved so much!
Look at it spin round and round.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. That's only natural, after you did such a good job of teaching me, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, I'm gonna have mine spin next to yours.
Go...!
se_event_unfading_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're so good at this, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My little sister and I used to play a lot together when we were kids. We even drew pictures on them and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really...?
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? What are you doing, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel like drawing a sketch of our tops spinning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A sketch?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, because they're spinning so beautifully together. I don't get many opportunities to draw many dynamic scenes like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But to be fair, all I'm gonna do is draw a quick sketch in my notebook.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You've improved so much since junior high.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, duh.
It's been like an eternity since then.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, I've gotta be at least this good if I'm actually gonna get into art school somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, can you show me once you're done?
I'm gonna go see if there's anything we can use for our stream.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Okay, we can meet back up later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A lot happened between then and now...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(But thank goodness.
It's great to see that she's still serious about art.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry about earlier, KAITO!
I didn't mean to force you to hide like that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's okay! You don't need to apologize.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Anyway, was that your friend you were talking to just now?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, she's my best friend from junior high.
That boy's her little brother, and that's his friend.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Really! It sounds like you're having a very lively New Year's Day.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And Airi, you have such a big smile on your face.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I am feeling pretty happy right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Happy?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes.
Because my friend hasn't turned her back on her dream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even though she loves to draw, there was a period in Ena's life when that became too painful...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But she managed to overcome all that, and is back to pursuing her dream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seeing her draw like this again makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I see...
Your friend must be a very hard-working person.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, she is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And her brother, Akito, is no different.
He and his team are apparently going over to the United States as a part of making their dream come true.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Wow...!
He's going overseas in pursuit of his dream! He also sounds like an incredible person.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Akito's also been a huge source of support for Ena.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <He has...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, he helped her when she was really down in the dumps.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After I asked him to look after her for me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It sounds like he's been doing it faithfully, ever since I asked.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I really appreciate him.
He was there for Ena when she really needed him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I see...
That must've been very hard...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This may sound strange, but I still feel a little guilty for asking Akito to do that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure what I said put a burden on him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <A burden?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was super selfish of me to ask him that, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't want Ena to be all alone, but I ended up asking someone to be there for her. Because I couldn't.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I feel that I should apologize to him, as well as thank him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Then, why don't you do that today?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You're all here together like this, so you may get a chance to do so today.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, KAITO, you're absolutely right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is a golden opportunity, so if I find the right time, I'll talk to him!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wonderful. Good luck, Airi!>
